title: Programmable Signal Generator (Three-Phase)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time three-phase sinusoidal signal generator with programmable magnitude, phase, frequency, and overlapping harmonics, 2 outputs, {Sample time} sets Block sample time; {Variation configuration} sets the type of magnitude, {Magnitude (value)} sets the magnitude of generated three-phase sine, {Rate of change (value/s)} sets the magnitude rate of change, {Step value (value)} sets the magnitude step value, {Modulation magnitude}, {Modulation frequency}, {Start time}, {Stop time}, {Table data} sets the magnitude table values, {Time values} sets the magnitude time values, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of generated three-phase sine, {Rate of change (Hz/s)} sets the frequency rate of change, {Step value (Hz)} sets the frequency step value, {Phase shift (deg)} sets the phase shift of generated three-phase sine, {Rate of change (deg/s)} sets the phase rate of change, {Step value (deg)} sets the phase step value, {Enable harmonic A} sets the harmonic A overlap, {Harmonic sequence} sets the type of harmonic A sequence, {Harmonic order} sets the order of harmonic, {Harmonic magnitude} sets the magnitude of harmonic, {Harmonic phase shift} sets the phase shift of harmonic and {Enable harmonic B} sets the harmonic B overlap. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Variation configuration
params.values: Type of magnitude variation Constant (default) | Ramp | Step | Modulation | Table

params.name: Magnitude (value)
params.values: Magnitude of generated three-phase sine wave 100 (default) | scalar

params.name: Start time
params.values: Start time of magnitude variation 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Stop time
params.values: Stop time of magnitude variation 0.6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of generated three-phase sine wave 100 (default) | scalar

params.name: Phase shift (deg)
params.values: Phase shift of generated three-phase sine wave 100 (default) | scalar

params.name: Harmonic sequence
params.values: Type of harmonic A sequence Zero Sequence (default) | Positive Sequence | Negative Sequence

params.name: Harmonic phase shift
params.values: Phase shift of harmonic A 180 (default) | scalar
